test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Identify the correctly spelt sentence. **
solution:
The correct answer is **"My favourite subject is Mathematics."****

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the subject is "**Mathematics**."
 
• The word **Mathematics** is spelled with two** 't's** and an** 's' **at the end.
 
 
• **Example**: *I love to learn **Mathematics**__.*
 
 
 
• The word Favourite** is spelled correctly in all the options.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Mathimatics** - Incorrect spelling
 
• **Option 2: Mathematecs **- Incorrect spelling
 
• **Option 3: Mathematiks** - Incorrect spelling
